svg.title: What each site holds and what the page fetches, one square per megabyte
svg.desc: A unit chart where each square is one megabyte. Filled squares are in the site, and hollow squares stay on webR's CDN and repo.r-wasm.org, where the page fetches them. A bare REPL with the engine bundled, the default, holds 46.6M, a 45.1M webR engine plus 1.5M of viewer and notices. With the engine from the CDN it holds 1.46M and the engine is fetched. A site with dplyr and ggplot2 holds 84.6M with the engine bundled, where the 38M of packages is 19M in repo/ and 19M again installed in library/. With the engine from the CDN it still holds 1.46M, and the page fetches the engine and 19M of packages.
svg.text: left on webR's CDN and repo.r-wasm.org, where the page fetches it
